title: SAP Business Data Cloud -BDC-Senior Manager
description:
Location: Noida

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 29, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1754619

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Consulting- SAP Business Data Cloud Architect – Senior Manager**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.

You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.

In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead enterprise-scale SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, and analytics transformation programs, defining architecture, governance, integration, and modern data engineering practices across SAP and non-SAP landscapes.
* Lead BDC and Datasphere architecture strategy for global S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Design enterprise data products, semantic models, data fabric, and analytical architectures.
* Define integration patterns between SAP S/4HANA, Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, BW/4HANA, and non-SAP platforms.
* Lead workshops, requirement gathering, fit-gap analysis, and solution roadmaps.
* Drive data governance, security, cataloging, lineage, and data quality initiatives.
* Provide architecture governance and oversee delivery teams during implementation.
* Guide migration from SAP BW/BW4HANA to SAP Business Data Cloud and Datasphere.
* Support testing, cutover, deployment planning, hypercare, and operational readiness.
* Mentor architects and consultants and support business development activities.

**SAP Business Data Cloud & Git-Based DevOps Expertise**

* Strong expertise in S/4HANA to SAP Business Data Cloud integration using GitHub/GitLab driven approaches.
* Automated extraction: SAP Datasphere artifacts exported as machine-readable definitions using SAP Datasphere CLI and automation scripts.
* Version control: Artifact definitions and deployment scripts maintained in central GitLab repositories for traceability and controlled change management.
* CI/CD deployment: GitLab pipelines export artifacts from source environments and deploy approved versions into target SAP Datasphere spaces/tenants through SAP Datasphere CLI.
* Define DevOps operating models, release governance, branching strategies, and automated deployment frameworks.

  

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC)
* SAP Datasphere
* SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
* SAP BW/4HANA
* SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics
* Data Modeling and Data Products
* SAP Integration Suite
* Data Governance and Metadata Management
* GitHub/GitLab DevOps and CI/CD
* SQL, Data Engineering and Data Virtualization

**Ideally, You'll Also Have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* SAP Business Data Could, SAP Datasphere, SAC, BW/4HANA, or related SAP certifications.
* Experience in RISE with SAP and cloud modernization programs.

**What We Look For**

* 12+ years of SAP experience with 5+ years in SAP Datasphere/Business Data Cloud architecture roles.
* At least 3 end-to-end SAP transformation or analytics modernization programs.
* Experience leading global architecture teams and stakeholder discussions at executive level.
* Strong consulting, solutioning, pre-sales, and delivery leadership capabilities.
* Experience working with multinational clients and distributed delivery teams.

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

  

**Our Commitment:** As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**Professional Development:** From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

**People and Culture:** In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**Benefits:** Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager | SAP CPI | Noida | SAP | DSA Emerging
description:
**Manager | SAP CPI | Noida | SAP | DSA Emerging**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 110189
  
• **Location**: Noida
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Enterprise technology must do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long-term growth. Learn more about ET&P

**Your work profile**

* Lead enterprise integration architecture, design, and delivery initiatives across SAP and non-SAP landscapes using SAP Integration Suite.
* Define and govern integration strategies, architecture standards, API frameworks, and best practices to support digital transformation programs.
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient integration solutions leveraging SAP Integration Suite components including Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and Event Mesh.
* Develop and govern enterprise integration artifacts including canonical data models, interface catalogs, integration patterns, mapping specifications, sequence diagrams, message flows, and error-handling frameworks.
* Lead the design and implementation of API-led integration architectures supporting hybrid and cloud-based application landscapes.
* Oversee the development and deployment of CPI iFlows, message mappings, value mappings, routing logic, transformation rules, and integration monitoring solutions.
* Design and implement event-driven integration architectures using SAP Event Mesh and asynchronous communication frameworks.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, functional teams, and technical teams to define integration requirements and solution roadmaps.
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP BTP, third-party applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Establish integration governance processes covering security, performance, monitoring, logging, exception management, and operational support.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex integration issues across enterprise environments.
* Drive adoption of enterprise integration patterns, reusable services, integration accelerators, and API governance frameworks.
* Mentor integration consultants and developers while driving technical excellence and capability development within the team.
* Support pre-sales activities, client proposals, solution estimations, architecture reviews, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Key Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise integration technologies with at least 5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Integration Suite.
* Proven experience leading integration architecture and delivery teams across large-scale transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in SAP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and Event Mesh.
* Deep understanding of API-led integration architectures, enterprise integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, and microservices-based integration approaches.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing CPI iFlows, message mappings, routing mechanisms, transformation logic, integration adapters, and monitoring solutions.
* Strong expertise in REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, XML, JSON, Web Services, and API integration technologies.
* Hands-on experience with message and value mappings, error handling frameworks, exception management, and operational support models.
* Experience designing canonical data models, interface catalogs, integration governance frameworks, and enterprise integration standards.
* Strong understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous integration concepts using SAP Event Mesh.
* Experience with SAP Cloud ALM, integration monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational governance.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration, SAP BTP services, SAP Ariba, SuccessFactors, Concur, and third-party application integrations.
* Experience with Groovy scripting and custom integration development within SAP Integration Suite.
* Strong stakeholder management, solution architecture, communication, and leadership capabilities.
* Ability to drive architectural decisions, governance reviews, technical discussions, and enterprise-wide integration strategies.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, SAP CPI, or SAP Certified Development Associate certifications are preferred.
* Certifications in Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Integration, API Management, TOGAF, or related technologies will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to SAP Activate, Agile, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise cloud transformation programs is highly desirable.
* Experience working in global delivery models, multinational environments, and large-scale SAP transformation initiatives is preferred.
* Strong consulting, leadership, stakeholder management, and solution governance experience will be an added advantage.

title: Presales Executive
description:
**Company:** Innov Arch

**Position:** Pre-Sales Executive / Telecalling Specialist

**Experience Required:** 0 to 1 Year (Freshers are welcome)

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month + Attractive Incentives

**Location:** Noida uttar pradesh

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Innov Arch**

At **Innov Arch**, we specialize in providing innovative, high-quality architectural and interior design solutions. From premium residential homes to corporate office spaces, we help clients bring their spatial visions to life.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an energetic and articulate **Pre-Sales Executive** to join our growth team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for potential clients interested in architectural and interior design services. Your primary responsibility will be contacting inbound leads, understanding client requirements, explaining our core offerings, and scheduling meetings for our senior design team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead Qualification & Outreach:**
* Connect with prospective clients via phone calls, WhatsApp, and email to qualify incoming inquiries.
* Understand initial client requirements (project type, space area, budget, timeline, and design expectations).
* **Consultation & Pitching:**
* Introduce **Innov Arch’s** portfolio, architectural services, interior packages, and design process clearly to potential clients.
* Answer preliminary queries regarding project timelines, estimation procedures, and site visit schedules.
* **Appointment Setting & Pipeline Management:**
* Schedule in-office meetings, virtual consultations, or site visits for Senior Architects and Interior Designers.
* Maintain and regularly update client details, call status, and follow-up notes in the company CRM/Excel.
* **Follow-up & Nurturing:**
* Consistently follow up with warm leads to encourage decision-making and maintain strong client engagement.
* Coordinate with the sales and design teams to ensure smooth handoff of qualified client leads.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (BBA, B.Com, BA, B.Sc, or Diploma in Sales/Marketing/Design preferred).
* **Experience:** 0 to 1 year of experience in pre-sales, telecalling, customer support, or client handling. *(Freshers with excellent communication skills are strongly encouraged to apply).*
* **Key Skills:**
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi.
* **Interpersonal Skills:** Confident, persuasive, polite, and customer-centric mindset.
* **Technical Basic:** Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets, phone handling, and basic CRM software usage.
* **Interest:** A genuine interest in architecture, home interiors, and real estate development is a major plus.

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Pay:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month fixed salary.
* **Incentives:** Performance-linked monthly incentives on converted client leads.
* **Growth:** Continuous training, mentorship from senior design leads, and career advancement opportunities into full Sales/Client Management roles.
* **Culture:** Friendly, supportive, and professional work environment

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
